description: Permanently delete a previously shared HTML. After this, the share URL returns 404. Use when the user says 'delete my share', 'take that page down', 'remove the demo I posted'. Uses this machine's stored edit token when it has one; otherwise falls back to the saved sync code, which can delete a share created on another machine — that path requires confirm: true.  Idempotent: re-deleting an already-deleted slug returns ok.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has confirmed deleting this specific slug. Required when no edit token for it exists on this machine.

name: qhs_delete
